sections.Profile:
Jackpot, produced by Bigliardini Elettronici Milano (BEM) in 1976, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine with a Canadian West prospecting theme. The game features two flippers, two pop bumpers, five standup targets, two kick-out holes, and dual inlanes.

- Manufacturer: Giorgio Massiniero
- Years made: 1976
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Prospecting, Canadian West, Single Player, Western, Wedgehead, Original Theme, 1970s, Mining
